sv.title: England slog Spanien i Madrid – trots utvisning
sv.summary: Det såg ut att bli en enkel historia, men efter en utvisning fick England slita i sitt anletes svett för att slå Spanien med 3–2 i Nations League.

en.title: England beat Spain in Madrid despite a red card
en.summary: It looked set to be an easy affair, but after a sending-off England had to work hard to beat Spain 3–2 in the Nations League.
